original.target_description: Experiment 1, blank outcome description and p. 8 locator; unique target test cannot be identified.

notes: Identity assessment: primary journal article OCR matches supplied title The Chameleon Effect: The Perception–Behavior Link and Social Interaction, authors Tanya L. Chartrand and John A. Bargh, year 1999, volume 76(6), pages 893–910. DOI is not printed and cannot independently be verified here. This is selected-page OCR (PDF pages 1, 5, 6, 7, 8), not the full article. No PDF is supplied for visual verification. Target ambiguous: p. 8 continues a confederate-expression main effect and interaction, both Fs < 1, then discusses awareness and Experiment 1 broadly. Antecedent p. 7 also reports nonsmiling-confederate mimicry F=4.16, p=.05, facial expression F=20.31 (OCR p < 0001), behavioral interaction F=9.36, p=.004, face rubbing F=5.71, p < .025, and foot shaking F=3.76, p=.06. No test was mapped by row order or numeric values. Final Experiment 1 N=35 is explicit but is retained only as a candidate for parent field-scope review because row correspondence is unresolved. Recruitment 39; 4 excluded (3 withheld videotape consent, 1 expressed suspicion). No N inference from df or group summation.
